# CANDIDATE: V14E_PARAM_SWEEP_KEEPER_TOP

**Filed:** 2026-07-23  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** parameter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The v14_enhanced_grinder sweep sought to improve baseline V14E performance by adjusting profit-lock parameters, trigger constraints, and timing filters. The top keeper combines bearish-specific settings (strike_offset_bear=0, min_triggers_bear=1) with aggressive profit-lock (tp1_premium_pct=0.3, runner_target_premium_pct=2.5) and a late morning entry filter (no_trade_before=09:35) to avoid premature entries while capturing extended moves.

## Mechanism

Entry logic: Bearish V14E setup triggers when:
- `no_trade_before` constraint satisfied (entry after 09:35 ET)
- `min_triggers_bear` >= 1 (single trigger sufficient)
- `strike_offset_bear` = 0 (ATM put)
Exit logic: 
- TP1 at 30% premium (`tp1_premium_pct=0.3`) on 50% of position (`tp1_qty_fraction=0.5`)
- Profit-lock arms at 5% gain (`profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.05`) with stop offset at 10% (`profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.1`)
- Runner target at 250% premium (`runner_target_premium_pct=2.5`)
- Premium stop at -20% (`premium_stop_pct_bear=-0.2`) as catastrophe cap
